summary: Tested Demand Studio Settings dialog close/refresh and Calendar pillar stats. Found and FIXED critical bug: missing toast import in SocialMediaPage.js prevented dialogs from closing after save. Backend APIs 14/14 passed. Frontend features verified working after fix.

bug_fixed.error: ReferenceError: toast is not defined at handleSavePillar
bug_fixed.cause: toast.success() and toast.error() were being called but toast was not imported
bug_fixed.impact: This was preventing ALL save dialogs from closing properly (pillar, audience, segment, account) because the code crashed before reaching setDialogOpen(false)
bug_fixed.verified: After fix, dialogs close correctly and data refreshes

critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: Missing 'import { toast } from sonner' in SocialMediaPage.js - was causing all Settings save operations to fail silently
seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned up test pillars (TEST_UI_Verification_Pillar, TEST_Toast_Fix_Pillar)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Toast import fix applied. Settings tab save handlers now work correctly - dialog closes and data refreshes. Calendar pillar stats mini-report displays actual_percentage, target_percentage, and over_target alerts correctly. No over-target alerts visible because current posts don't exceed pillar targets by >10%.

frontend_settings_dialog_close.verification: Dialog closes after save, new pillar appears in list

frontend_calendar_pillar_stats.content_verified: Shows 'Sin pilar' with '6 posts 100%' and status badges (2 prod, 1 edit)

api_verification.GET /api/demand-studio/social/calendar/p: 200 OK - Returns actual_percentage, target_percentage, over_target fields

screenshots: .screenshots/calendar_view.png - Calendar with pillar stats mini-report visible
.screenshots/settings_final.png - Settings tab with Content Pillars, Audiences, Segments sections
